dedupe_keys.name: x ray ct data fatigue damage in glass fibre polyester composite used for wind turbine blades

description: Jespersen, Kristine M. and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The resource presents X-ray computed-tomography observations and associated videos of fatigue progression in a unidirectional glass-fibre/polyester composite used for wind-turbine blades. The material is made from non-crimp fabric and scanned with a Zeiss Xradia Versa 520. The deposit links its views to figures in the cited fatigue-damage assessment paper. This is experimental material evidence for structural and condition assessment, not a complete blade-scale failure model. The description does not specify all load histories, voxel sizes or sample counts; media and scan bodies were not viewed or downloaded. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
